definitions.explanation: A permanent design made by inserting ink into the skin. In Japanese, タトゥー specifically refers to Western-style tattoos, as distinct from traditional Japanese {入|い}れ{墨|ずみ} (irezumi).

examples.japanese: タトゥー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧タトゥー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: There's a tattoo on my arm.

examples.japanese: タトゥー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}れない→入る：00494_hairu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you have a tattoo, you may not be allowed to enter Japanese hot springs.

notes:
USAGE:
The collocation タトゥー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to get/put in a tattoo) is the standard way to say "get a tattoo." タトゥー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧ describes the state of having a tattoo.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- タトゥー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to get a tattoo
- タトゥー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to have a tattoo
- タトゥー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to remove a tattoo
- タトゥー⟦シール→シール：09597_shiiru⟧: temporary tattoo sticker

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, tattoos carry a strong association with yakuza (organized crime), so many public baths, swimming pools, and gyms prohibit entry for tattooed individuals. タトゥー is used for Western-style tattoos and carries a somewhat more neutral or fashionable connotation than the traditional term {入|い}れ{墨|ずみ}, though the social restrictions apply equally to both.
